DISTRICT COURT OF EXAMPLETON
Order of Attachment / Garnishment

Case reference: AB-1042/24
Date: 14 March 2026

TO: Northbank AG, Account Services

You are hereby ordered to attach and hold funds in the account of the debtor named
below, up to the amount stated, pursuant to the enforcement order in the
above-referenced case.

Debtor:        Jordan A. Meyer
Account (IBAN): DE44 5001 0517 5407 3249 31
Amount to seize: EUR 4,250.00

This order takes effect immediately upon receipt.

Registrar, District Court of Exampleton

DISTRICT COURT OF EXAMPLETON
Order of Attachment / Garnishment

Case reference: AB-1042/24
Date: 16 March 2026

TO: Northbank AG

Further to our earlier correspondence regarding the account holder M. Meyer, please
attach the outstanding balance owed. The sum concerned is in the region of four
thousand two hundred euros; the exact figure should match the enforcement schedule
previously provided.

Registrar, District Court of Exampleton

amount.source_quote: in the region of four thousand two hundred euros

items.letter:
DISTRICT COURT OF EXAMPLETON
Order Restricting a Prior Attachment / Garnishment

Case reference: AB-1042/24
Date: 22 March 2026

TO: Northbank AG, Account Services

With reference to our Order of Attachment dated 14 March 2026 in the above case,
which directed the attachment of funds in the amount of EUR 4,250.00, the court
hereby RESTRICTS that order. The amount to be attached and held is reduced to:

Debtor:          Jordan A. Meyer
Account (IBAN):  DE44 5001 0517 5407 3249 31
Restricted amount to seize: EUR 1,267.00

All other terms of the original order remain in force.

Registrar, District Court of Exampleton
